content.short: Blocktrust is providing tooling on top of Atala PRISM
content.description:
Blocktrust has been building tools around Atala PRISM since its early days. Currently, we offer the only browser-extension wallet for Atala PRISM, alongside tooling for SSI Analytics and a simple tool for issuing credentials based on Atala PRISM, among other services.

If you are looking to integrate SSI solutions into your project—be it for sign-in, KYC purposes, DAO rights management, or any other use case—we are more than happy to help you integrate the Atala PRISM technology stack or guide you using our products. Additionally, we are seeking more developers to contribute to our expanding portfolio of solutions, most of which are based on .Net.
